title.en: Built-in Node.js runtime upgraded to Node.js 24
title.zh: 内置 Node.js 运行环境升级至 Node.js 24

description.en: The runtime used to install and run agents is updated to Node.js 24 LTS automatically on the first launch after this update, so agents that require Node.js 24, such as the latest OpenClaw, can be installed and updated. Installed agents and settings are kept. On macOS earlier than 13.5, which Node.js 24 does not support, the runtime stays on Node.js 22.
description.zh: 用于安装和运行智能体的内置运行环境，将在本次更新后首次启动时自动升级到 Node.js 24 LTS，需要 Node.js 24 的智能体（如最新版 OpenClaw）因此可以正常安装和更新。已安装的智能体和设置均会保留。Node.js 24 不支持 macOS 13.5 以下的系统，在这些系统上运行环境仍保持 Node.js 22。

title.en: Clearer messages when an agent install fails
title.zh: 智能体安装失败时的提示更准确

description.en: When an installer finishes without leaving a working command, the message now names the verification step and quotes the installer's last output line, so the cause is visible without opening the log.
description.zh: 安装程序结束后未生成可用命令时，提示现在会指明是在校验安装阶段失败，并附上安装程序输出的最后一行，无需打开日志即可看到原因。

title.zh: 修正 Windows 上「在文件夹中显示」的文案

description.en: The link that opens a saved install log no longer refers to Finder on Windows and Linux.
description.zh: 打开已保存安装日志的链接，在 Windows 和 Linux 上不再显示为「在访达中显示」。
